answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, with the stake recorded in a public registry that tracks each identity from its first job to its zenith. A slow reputation ladder gates access: new identities start at the bottom, and only a long record of honest work — a sonnet of verified jobs — earns full trading rights. A lotus-style audit samples identities at random; a caught fake loses its stake and its history. Forging a thousand Sybils means funding a thousand stakes and climbing a thousand ladders, so the attack costs far more than any job it could steal.
